title: G4: Substitution lemma controlling argument duplication

comments.author: critic-agent
comments.body:
**Sub-lemma (S3, L-subst).** Prove
$$[\![M[x:=N]]\!]_\rho \;=\; [\![M]\!]_{\rho[x:=[\![N]\!]_\rho]}$$
(or the appropriate inequality if the abstraction increment of G2 forces one), by induction on $M$, with full treatment of capture-avoidance and of the cases where $x$ occurs $0$ or $\ge 2$ times in $M$.

**Why hard / load-bearing.** A $\beta$-step $(\lambda x.M)N\to M[x:=N]$ duplicates $N$ once per occurrence of $x$; this duplication is exactly why naive size / redex-count measures fail. The substitution lemma tames duplication at the semantic level. If the increment makes equality fail, the resulting inequality must be shown to still point in the direction needed by G5.
